column1: # Audio generation queue, worked strictly top to bottom. An entry is finished
# when every chapter of every listed book is in the ledger AND on disk; the
# generator then falls through to the next line on its own, so completing a
# language needs no edit here.
# Order is by observed traffic (Umami, 30d: FI 21 / CN 18 + SG 12 / DE 7 / FR 4),
# not by corpus order. English is deliberately LAST: en is the largest audience
# but the best served elsewhere — English audio Bibles are abundant, Finnish
# 1933 and Delitzsch Hebrew are not.
# 2026-09-14: zh-cuv moved to the front on usage statistics (maintainer's
# call). The 30d figures above already put Chinese-reading traffic
# (CN + SG) ahead of FI; zh-cuv is also ~2.07M characters against
# fi-1933's ~4.19M, so it completes sooner. fi-1933 pauses at GEN 27.
# 2026-09-18: ja-freedom-2026 added and placed ahead of fi-1933
# (maintainer's call) — Finnish pauses at 645/1189 and resumes after
# Japanese completes (~1.70M chars).
# 2026-09-21: reordered to ONE public-domain bible per language, in the
# maintainer's stated order: he, ru, de, fr, es, it, sv, en. This supersedes the
# traffic ordering above. fi-1933 moves to LAST (maintainer's call) to be finalised after
# the eight, so it keeps its 956/1337 chapters and is deferred, not abandoned.
# Measured sizes at this date (raw verse characters):
#   he 2.04M  ru 3.22M  de 4.00M  es 3.98M  en 4.09M  it 4.20M  fr 4.21M
#   sv 4.64M  fi remaining 1.43M   -- the eight total 30.4M
# Paid lifetime was 7.77M of a 20.5M cap (12.7M headroom) and the Azure credit
# (EUR 171.73, expires ~11 Oct 2026) covers roughly 11.4M, so the MONEY binds
# first: expect he + ru + de complete and fr part-way, then a clean stop at a
# cap. Everything below fr is queued for later credit, not for this run.
# Every text here is Public Domain and complete (OT+NT). Excluded on purpose:
#   tr  YTC 2023      CC BY-ND — "no derivatives" likely bars synthesised audio
#   hi  IRV 2019      CC BY-SA — usable, but the audio inherits share-alike
#   la  Vulgate       no Azure voice exists
#   grc TR / BYZ1904  no Azure voice, and NT only
#   ar  Qur'an/hadith NOT to be synthesised — recitation needs tajwid, not TTS
# text-id                voice                    lang    books
